chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Abu Muhammad al-Razi from al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Ibrahim ibn Bakr ibn Sammal from al-Fadl ibn Uthman who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
Whoever is wise, Paradise will be concluded for him, God willing.

key_terms.خُتِمَ لَهُ: concluded for him (his end/fate is sealed)
key_terms.عَاقِلًا: wise person (one who possesses intellect and discernment)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a wise person according to Imam Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) linking the state of being 'Aqil (wise/discerning) to the sealing of one's fate with Paradise, emphasizing that true wisdom is not merely intellectual but a spiritual disposition that guarantees salvation. This concept reflects the Shia emphasis on 'Aql as a divine faculty that guides the believer toward righteous action and ultimate success. The phrase 'khatima lahu' suggests that wisdom serves as the concluding characteristic of a believer's life, securing their entry into Jannah.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) says, “God-willing, a wise person will end up in Paradise.”
